description: One row per released report_date on or after p_start_date: that day's summed jfb_production_stats.volume (CY) and area (SF), summed jfb_daily_activities duration in hours (GOH -- every activity counts, delay or not, same convention as dvw-jfb-goh-v2), and summed NOH (only activities with no delay_code_id, same convention as dvw-jfb-noh-v2 -- feeds the Realized To-Date summary's CY/NOH rate). Backs the Realized To-Date report's weekly log and every downstream rate/projection/cumulative-chart calculation, which does that math client-side over these pre-aggregated per-day rows -- replaces the non-native app's fetchReleasedReportSeries, which instead pages through every raw production_stats/daily_events row into the browser (1000-row pages, chunked event_deletions lookups) to sum client-side; grouping server-side avoids that scaling workaround entirely. Also backs the Weekly Summary report (week + project-to-date CY/SF/GOH/NOH), replacing the two separate dvw-jfb-metric-cy-v2/-sf calls it used before this column was added. Draft reports are excluded (status='released' only), matching the non-native app's fetchReleasedReportSeries filter.
direct_sql: SELECT r.report_date, COALESCE(ps_sum.total_volume, 0) AS cy, COALESCE(ps_sum.total_area, 0) AS sf, COALESCE(ps_sum.total_tons, 0) AS tons, COALESCE(goh_sum.total_hours, 0) AS goh, COALESCE(noh_sum.total_hours, 0) AS noh FROM usdf.jfb_reports r LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.report_id, SUM(ps.volume) AS total_volume, SUM(ps.area) AS total_area, SUM(ps.tons) AS total_tons FROM usdf.jfb_production_stats ps GROUP BY ps.report_id) ps_sum ON ps_sum.report_id = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT da.project_id, da.start_date_time::date AS activity_date, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0) AS total_hours FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da WHERE da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY da.project_id, da.start_date_time::date) goh_sum ON goh_sum.project_id = r.project_id AND goh_sum.activity_date = r.report_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT da.project_id, da.start_date_time::date AS activity_date, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0) AS total_hours FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da WHERE da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND da.delay_code_id IS NULL GROUP BY da.project_id, da.start_date_time::date) noh_sum ON noh_sum.project_id = r.project_id AND noh_sum.activity_date = r.report_date WHERE r.project_id = p_project_id AND r.status = 'released' AND r.report_date >= p_start_date ORDER BY r.report_date

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the series to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive floor on report_date -- pass the project's production_start_date (or a very early date to mean 'no floor', same convention as dvw-jfb-metric-cy-v2's Total column) to get the full history.

columns.name: cy
columns.description: Summed production_stats.volume for that report; 0 when the report has no production rows.

columns.name: sf
columns.description: Summed production_stats.area for that report; 0 when the report has no production rows.

columns.name: tons
columns.description: Summed jfb_production_stats.tons for that report; 0 when the report has no production rows. Feeds the Realized To-Date report on tonnage-paid placement projects, which measure in TON instead of CY.

columns.name: goh
columns.description: Summed daily_activities duration (hours) for that project+date, every activity regardless of delay_code_id; 0 when no activities were logged that date.

columns.name: noh
columns.description: Summed daily_activities duration (hours) for that project+date, only activities with no delay_code_id (productive time); 0 when none.
